briefdescription.para: Encode binary data to standard RFC 4648 Base64 string.

detaileddescription.para: Uses alphabet [A-Za-z0-9+/] and adds = padding when needed. Always null-terminates the output if dst_size > 0.

parameterdescription.para: Input binary data.
Length of input binary data in bytes.
[out] Output string buffer.
Capacity of output buffer in bytes (must be >= syn_base64_calc_encoded_size(src_len)).
[out] Optional pointer to receive character length written (excluding null).

simplesect.para: true on success, false if parameters are invalid or buffer is too small.

briefdescription.para: Decode an RFC 4648 standard Base64 string into binary data.

detaileddescription.para: Automatically skips whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, CR, LF). Rejects invalid non-base64 characters and malformed padding.

parameterdescription.para: Input Base64 string (null-terminated or bounded by src_len).
Length of input string (or 0 to determine via strlen).
[out] Output binary buffer.
Capacity of output buffer in bytes.
[out] Optional pointer to receive actual binary bytes written.

simplesect.para: true on success, false if input contains invalid characters or destination is too small.
